purpose: Test whether non-target pools add information beyond a freely temperature-calibrated terminal UMAREN market; direct market replacement is secondary.

prior_art_equivalence.crux_joint_T0_T1: done: 9h, lambda<=2023, eval 2024-25, market LL 3.343 < Harville 3.380
prior_art_equivalence.rule: T0/T1 head-to-head are anchors only; novelty is calibrated nested offset and T2 soft-fukusho

known.TANPUK: win/place odds time series plus pool-total votes
known.UMAREN: all unordered-pair odds time series plus pool-total votes

data.vote_rule: pool totals optional liquidity metadata only

sealed_caveat: 2024/2025 already opened for T0/T1 head-to-head; pristine only for T2 and nested offset

population.base_requirement: all starters have TANPUK win/place odds
population.target_grid_missingness: after base set, exclude as target-market settlement unavailable and report yearly

sample_space: all unordered starter pairs C(n,2), positive and normalized within race
primary_loss: race-level categorical logloss of realized unordered top2 pair

null_market.base: power-law devig m_cal proportional to (1/odds)^gamma, gamma fit <=Y-1
null_market.temperature_null: q_temp proportional to m_cal^a0, a0 fit <=Y-1
null_market.pass_rule: must beat rolling calibrated temperature null
null_market.parameterization: gamma and a0 are the same exponent; fit c0=gamma*a0 directly, or fix gamma and refit only a0; alternative c=gamma*a

primary_comparison.alternative: q_cross proportional to m_cal^a * q_LOPO^beta; a,beta fit <=Y-1
primary_comparison.collinearity_rule: center log q_LOPO and log m_cal within race; if design rank deficient or condition number>1e12, drop duplicate regressor and return q_cross=q_temp bitwise through the same code path

t2.claim: unique only under declared MaxEnt prior
t2.form: win marginals equality; penalty w_fuku*sum_i(Pq(i in top-k)-tau_i)^2; k=places(n)

power.noise_sd: sqrt(2*delta), label-free declared convention, not a derivation
power.freeze_rule: commit numeric value to spec.json before any 2019-2023 performance; later change requires new version

stage0.structure_loader_years: 2019..2023 allowed for odds, field size, date, entropy

development.stage1_entry_condition: practical_floor_nats must be numeric and committed before any Stage1 run

hierarchy.conditional_secondary: UB3_OFFSET_U3 only if T2 roundtrip passes

placebos.P2: matched-race source time shift using TANSHO entropy cells
placebos.P4: sanity only; keep real <=Y-1 gamma,a,beta, resample Y outcomes from m_cal 200 draws
placebos.P5: constructive assert only: uniform q_LOPO must give abs(delta)<=1e-12 via collinearity code path; no draws and not Gate evidence

M1.comparison: nested cross-pool alternative minus calibrated temperature null
M1.PASS_PRACTICAL: CI95 upper<0, practical floor, 4/5 years, 4/5 seeds, all LOO CI upper<0, P1/P2 pass, multiplicity adjusted
M1.PASS_SIGNAL: same statistical conditions below practical floor

M2.input: pre non-target pools plus UMAREN pre-to-terminal drift fit <=Y-1
M2.progression: only PASS_PRACTICAL can propose separate ticket experiment

prior_art.note: T0/T1 head-to-head already done (crux_joint) -> anchor only

t2_roundtrip.consequence: T2未実装で停止。UB3はStage 1のGate armから除外し、Gate armはUB2の1本(Bonferroni係数1)

power.review_item: 宣言慣習SD(noise)=sqrt(2Δ)により床が0.884 nats(全額投入参考0.255の約3.5倍、anchor差0.042の約21倍)となりPASS-PRACTICALは実質到達不能。変更は新版で
